entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker and Gatewatch member who leads the plan against Tezzeret and joins Chandra's desperate idea.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker who volunteers to be the disruptor herself in the hollowed-out thopter.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A death-mage planeswalker who insists on going alone to duel and distract Tezzeret.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: Chandra's mother and a renegade leader who leads the ground team against the turret.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: A metalsmith planeswalker who built the disruptor thopter and transmutes attacking thopters to lead.

entities.name: Rashmi
entities.description: The aether-engineer who designed Hope of Ghirapur to undo her own earlier invention.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker who senses aether lines and lifts a peacewalker with vines.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker with a double axe who protects the ground team and calls Chandra little candle.

entities.name: Oviya Pashiri
entities.description: An old lifecrafter who provides the gremlin-filled crate and mobilizes renegades.

entities.name: Shadowblayde
entities.description: A young elf renegade caught in the peacewalker's treads and freed by Ajani.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: A vedalken planeswalker and Consulate inspector who sabotages Heart of Kiran and the disruptor, then planeswalks away.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: The Consulate leader building the Planar Bridge, whom Liliana wants to duel.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage who helped Kari Zev defeat the blockade; Liliana says he must not face Tezzeret.

entities.name: Kari Zev
entities.description: A pirate captain who helped bring down the Skysovereign.

entities.name: Baral
entities.description: A Consulate captain whom Chandra fought before this scene.

entities.name: Kiran Nalaar
entities.description: Chandra's late father, who designed Heart of Kiran.

entities.name: The Gatewatch
entities.description: The planeswalker group working with the renegades.

entities.name: The Renegades
entities.description: The rebel inventors fighting the Consulate.

entities.name: The Consulate
entities.description: The government defending the Spire with turrets and automata.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The city under blockade.

entities.name: The Aether Spire
entities.description: The glimmering tower where Tezzeret assembles the Planar Bridge.

entities.name: Aether Hub
entities.description: A facility lost by the renegades.

entities.name: Regatha
entities.description: Chandra's former location where Gideon and Jace asked for her help.

entities.name: Heart of Kiran
entities.description: The renegades' skyship, whose fuel system Dovin wrecks.

entities.name: Skysovereign
entities.description: The Consulate flagship that sinks slowly toward the city.

entities.name: The Planar Bridge
entities.description: Tezzeret's artifact for opening doors between worlds, assembled at the Spire.

entities.name: Hope of Ghirapur
entities.description: A specially modified thopter carrying an aetheric disruptor meant to destroy the Planar Bridge.

entities.name: Aetheric disruptor
entities.description: A device that produces a one-time energetic shock to fry the Bridge's inner ring.

entities.name: The aether turret
entities.description: A huge aether-powered cannon at the Spire's base that destroys anything flying.

entities.name: Gremlins
entities.description: Aether-eating creatures released to drain the turret.

entities.name: Peacewalker
entities.description: Huge Consulate rolling war machine draped in banners.

events.summary: Gideon watches the Skysovereign sink; Jace and Kari have broken the blockade, and Gideon insists the target is the Planar Bridge.
events.quote: "It's fallen," Gideon said. "And the blockade's gone with it.

events.summary: Pia, Saheeli and Rashmi reveal Hope of Ghirapur, a modified thopter carrying an aetheric disruptor to cripple the Planar Bridge.
events.quote: "Rashmi and Saheeli have designed a specially modified thopter," said Pia.

events.summary: Pia warns that a huge aether turret at the Spire's base can destroy anything that flies and proposes a ground team to take it out.
events.quote: "I might have a way to take it out," Pia said.

events.summary: Gideon keeps Chandra on the ship while Nissa and Ajani join Pia on the ground team.
events.quote: "I'll go along with the ground team," Ajani said.

events.summary: Liliana convinces a reluctant Gideon that she must go alone and unarmed to duel and distract Tezzeret.
events.quote: I have to go alone, unarmed, or else your whole plan falls apart.

events.summary: Pia's team meets Mrs. Pashiri, who gives them a crate containing a weapon against the turret, and brings renegade inventors.
events.quote: "A weapon against the Consulate," Mrs. Pashiri said.

events.summary: Chandra and Saheeli defend the airship against thopter swarms; Saheeli turns attackers to lead.
events.quote: Saheeli reached out with a spell, magically transmuting their delicate metals to clumsy lead.

events.summary: Chandra and Saheeli talk about Chandra's father and whether Saheeli would leave Kaladesh.
events.quote: "I'm sorry about your father," Saheeli said, unbidden.

events.summary: The ground team fights through automata and peacewalkers around the turret; Shadowblayde is caught in a peacewalker's treads.
events.quote: She lost her footing and fell sideways, dragged toward the spikes as she struggled to release herself.

events.summary: Dovin Baan infiltrates the airship and destroys the crucial disruptor module of Hope of Ghirapur.
events.quote: And just as Chandra recognized it, Dovin crushed it.

events.summary: Ajani frees Shadowblayde from the treads and Nissa lifts the peacewalker to save them.
events.quote: Nissa stood under the chassis, her arms holding up the great mechanical beast

events.summary: The renegades release dozens of gremlins that devour the turret's aether and disable it.
events.quote: Torn open and drained, the turret went dark and the cannon sagged, aetherless and useless.

events.summary: Dovin warns the ship has lost fuel and planeswalks away while Chandra fires blindly.
Saheeli discovers the hollowed-out thopter; the group debates calling off the attack.
events.quote: "We need to call it off," he said.

events.summary: Chandra proposes to be the disruptor herself by riding the thopter into the Bridge; Gideon objects but she insists.
events.quote: "From close range, I could be the disruptor.

events.summary: Gideon relents and decides to go with Chandra.

relations.quote: "I'm coming with you, Mom," Chandra said immediately.

relations.note: Chandra calls it her dad's ship.

relations.quote: The Gatewatch had come together to fight the same enemies

relations.note: He sabotages her plan and is attacked by her.
relations.quote: "My error is now remedied," Dovin said.
The Consulate ship sagged in the air

relations.note: She plans to duel and kill him.
relations.quote: I believe having your flesh scoured from your skeleton can be a very effective distraction.

relations.note: They design Hope of Ghirapur together.
relations.quote: Rashmi and Saheeli have designed a specially modified thopter
a device capable of incapacitating the Bridge and stopping its operation for good.
